title: DeepSeek Super-agent, explained with Napoleon's army (60 seconds)
description:
Napoleon led more than a hundred thousand soldiers, and he could not shout orders at each one. His fix was one man: Berthier, his chief of staff, who turned what Napoleon wanted into written orders for the corps.

DeepSeek's Super-agent research prototype works the same way for AI coding agents. One router agent takes your request, opens a ticket and hands it to a worker agent with its own session and its own folder. Many workers run at once, and the router speaks up only when you must decide or can use a result.

The takeaway: the limit isn't your agents. It's your attention.

Try it (open source, MIT, a research prototype and not an official DeepSeek product):
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype
Ask your coding agent: "Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me."
